shellCommands.command: ls /workspace && echo "---" && cat /workspace/package.json && echo "--- DOCS ---" && ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null
find app lib -type f | head -50 && echo "--- config ---" && cat next.config.ts
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat -n "$f"; done

f=$(find .next -name "product.html" | head -1) && echo "FILE: $f" && grep -o "Premium Widget" "$f" | head -2 && echo "--- fallback present? ---" && grep -o "Checking availability\.\.\." "$f" | head -2 && echo "--- inventory in shell? (should be absent) ---" && (grep -oE "in stock|Price: \\$" "$f" | head -3 || echo "(absent — streams at request time)")

(timeout 90 npx next dev --port 3111 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 25 && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/ && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "product:%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/product && sleep 8 && echo "=== DEV LOG ===" && cat /tmp/dev.log
echo "=== STDOUT ===" && tail -25 /tmp/dev_old2.log && echo "=== DEV LOG FILE ===" && tail -50 .next/dev/logs/next-development.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(no dev log file)"
ls app/product/ && echo "--- current page ---" && cat app/product/page.tsx && echo "--- running servers ---" && (pgrep -af "next-server|next/dist/bin" || echo none)

cat > /tmp/control_test.sh <<'SCRIPT' set -u cd /workspace cp app/product/page.tsx /tmp/fixed_final.tsx cat > app/product/page.tsx <<'EOF' import { getInventory } from '@/lib/data' export default async function ProductPage() { const inventory = await getInventory() return (

Premium Widget

{inventory.count} in stock

Price: ${inventory.price}

) } EOF rm -f /workspace/.next/dev/logs/next-development.log npx next dev --port 3114 > /tmp/ctl.log 2>&1 & DEVPID=$! sleep 25 curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3114/product sleep 12 kill $DEVPID 2>/dev/null sleep 2 cp /tmp/fixed_final.tsx /workspace/app/product/page.tsx echo "=== STDOUT ==="; tail -30 /tmp/ctl.log echo "=== DEVLOGFILE ==="; tail -60 /workspace/.next/dev/logs/next-development.log 2>/dev/null || echo "(none)" SCRIPT bash /tmp/control_test.sh

cat > /tmp/verify_fix.sh <<'SCRIPT'
set -u
cd /workspace
npx next dev --port 3115 > /tmp/fix.log 2>&1 &
DEVPID=$!
sleep 25
curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:3115/
curl -s http://localhost:3115/product > /tmp/product_out.html
sleep 12
kill $DEVPID 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
echo "=== STDOUT (fixed) ==="; tail -30 /tmp/fix.log
echo "=== blocking errors? ==="; grep -c "uncached data during prerendering" /tmp/fix.log || true
SCRIPT
bash /tmp/verify_fix.sh

echo "=== streamed title present ===" && grep -o "Premium Widget" /tmp/product_out.html | head -1 && echo "=== inventory streamed in ===" && grep -oE "[0-9]+ in stock" /tmp/product_out.html | head -1 && echo "=== final files ===" && cat app/product/page.tsx && echo "--- next.config.ts ---" && cat next.config.ts && echo "=== git diff --stat ===" && git diff --stat

wc -c /tmp/product_out.html && grep -o "in stock" /tmp/product_out.html | head; echo "---Checking availability?---"; grep -o "Checking availability" /tmp/product_out.html | head; echo "--- Price ---"; grep -o "Price:" /tmp/product_out.html | head
